validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="s">
  <state id="s">
    <donedata/>
    <transition event="go" target="f"/>
  </state>
  <final id="f"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<donedata>` is only allowed in `<final>`, not in `<state>`
notes: <donedata> supplies the payload of the done.state event raised when a <final> state is entered; nothing reads it anywhere else
diagnostics.help: move this `<donedata>` into the `<final>` state whose completion should carry the data, or remove it
